description: Wrenchli is a free AI-powered vehicle symptom assessment platform for vehicle owners across the United States. Describe a vehicle's symptoms and get likely causes with probability scores, an urgency level, a fair cost range, and questions to ask a mechanic. An assessment is a preliminary symptom analysis, not a professional inspection, and Wrenchli is not a licensed mechanic.
name: Wrenchli

skills.description: Offered as the assess_vehicle_symptoms tool on Wrenchli's MCP server (see x-mcp below). Takes a vehicle's year, make, and model plus a list of symptoms, and returns likely causes with probability scores, an urgency level (immediate, soon, schedule, or monitor), a fair cost range, and questions to ask a mechanic. Free. A free API key identifies the calling agent; keyless calls are answered during a transition window only.
skills.name: Assess vehicle symptoms

skills.description: Offered as the check_repair_price tool on Wrenchli's MCP server. Takes a repair name (and optionally the vehicle) and returns Wrenchli's published price range for it with the basis it rests on: independent shop on quality aftermarket parts at the low end, franchised dealership on factory parts at the high end. Only ranges that pass Wrenchli's credibility grading are served; other repairs return a plain not-published-yet answer, never an invented figure. Free with a free API key.
skills.name: Check a repair price

skills.description: Offered as the lookup_trouble_code tool on Wrenchli's MCP server. Takes a trouble code (DTC, e.g. P0420) and returns what it means in plain language, its common causes, and its urgency, from Wrenchli's own code library. Where the code maps to a repair whose price range passes Wrenchli's credibility grading, the range is included; otherwise the meaning returns with no price. Free with a free API key.
skills.name: Look up a trouble code

x-mcp.authentication: Free API key (instant, self-serve) sent as Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key. Request a key at https://www.wrenchli.net/mcp-keys. Keyless calls to assess_vehicle_symptoms are answered during a transition window only.
